# LiftoffKit

> Paste an app URL → get a full launch kit by email.

LiftoffKit (https://liftoffkit.app) turns a public product URL into launch-ready assets for AI builders, designers, and vibe coders.

## Product
- Input: a public app / SaaS URL
- Output ZIP: landing & store copy, logo + favicon set, OG/social images, App Store / Product Hunt screenshot mockups, privacy + terms drafts, 7-day X (Twitter) launch plan (Markdown + CSV)
- Liftoff+ adds a hosted landing page built from the kit
- No auto-posting to X or Product Hunt — plan only
- Generated privacy/terms are drafts, not legal advice

## Pricing
- Liftoff: $29 one-time (full asset ZIP by email)
- Liftoff+: $79 one-time (everything in Liftoff + hosted landing)

## Key pages
- Home / marketing: https://liftoffkit.app/
- Sitemap: https://liftoffkit.app/sitemap.xml
- Contact: info@liftoffkit.app

## Status
Soft launch pending. Checkout and paid generation not yet live on the public site.
